# Generated Files (Vertex.ai)

Agar aapko check karna ho ki files bani hain, to ye list verify karo:

1. `index.html` - Main premium login page
2. `styles.css` - Premium black/luxury styling
3. `app.js` - Sign-in validation/status script
4. `mobile-preview.html` - Mobile single-file login preview
5. `preview.html` - Quick redirect page to mobile preview
6. `README.md` - Quick start guide
7. `MOBILE_PREVIEW.md` - Mobile-only Hindi guide
8. `preview-login.svg` - Static preview asset

## Open order (mobile users)
1. `mobile-preview.html`
2. `preview.html`
3. `index.html`
